   137	// Generate exactly the same deterministic SPD matrix as the original benchmark.
   138	// The O(N^3) Gram product is shared among OpenMP threads and symmetry halves
   139	// the work without changing the order of any individual dot product.
   140	void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double> &matrix, size_t n) {
   141	  std::vector<double> randomMatrix(n * n);
   142	  unsigned int seed = 42;
   143	  for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {
   144	    randomMatrix[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
   145	  }
   146	
   147	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)
   148	  for (long long iValue = 0; iValue < static_cast<long long>(n); ++iValue) {
   149	    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(iValue);
   150	    for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
   151	      double sum = 0.0;
   152	      for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
   153	        sum += randomMatrix[i * n + k] * randomMatrix[j * n + k];
   154	      }
   155	      if (i == j) {
   156	        sum += static_cast<double>(n);
   157	      }
   158	      matrix[i * n + j] = sum;
   159	      matrix[j * n + i] = sum;
   160	    }
   161	  }
   162	}
   163	
   164	// Convert root's row-major matrix into rank-major, block-cyclic row storage.
   165	// Each local block row is column-major on the GPU, permitting one large DGEMM
   166	// per owned tile row during every trailing update.
   167	void packDistributedMatrix(const std::vector<double> &matrix,
   168	                           std::vector<double> &packed, size_t n, int blockSize,
   169	                           int tileCount, int ranks,
   170	                           const std::vector<int> &displacements) {
   171	  const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
   172	  const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
   173	
   174	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   175	  for (int blockRow = 0; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
   176	    const int owner = blockRow % ranks;
   177	    const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow / ranks);
   178	    double *destination =
   179	        packed.data() + displacements[owner] + localSlot * blockStride;
   180	    const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
   180	    const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
   181	    const size_t rows = std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - globalRow);
   182	    for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
   183	      for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
   184	        destination[column * blockSize + row] =
   185	            matrix[(globalRow + row) * n + column];
   186	      }
   187	    }
   188	  }
   189	}
   190	
   191	// Restore the conventional row-major, explicitly lower-triangular result.
   192	void unpackDistributedMatrix(const std::vector<double> &packed,
   193	                             std::vector<double> &matrix, size_t n,
   194	                             int blockSize, int tileCount, int ranks,
   195	                             const std::vector<int> &displacements) {
   196	  const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
   197	  const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
   198	
   199	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   200	  for (int blockRow = 0; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
   201	    const int owner = blockRow % ranks;
   202	    const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow / ranks);
   203	    const double *source =
   204	        packed.data() + displacements[owner] + localSlot * blockStride;
   205	    const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
   206	    const size_t rows = std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - globalRow);
   207	    for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
   208	      const size_t outputRow = globalRow + row;
   209	      for (size_t column = 0; column <= outputRow; ++column) {
   210	        matrix[outputRow * n + column] = source[column * blockSize + row];
   211	      }
   212	      std::fill(matrix.begin() + outputRow * n + outputRow + 1,
   213	                matrix.begin() + (outputRow + 1) * n, 0.0);
   214	    }
   215	  }
   216	}

   218	bool distributedCholesky(std::vector<double> &localMatrix, size_t n,
   219	                         int blockSize, int tileCount, int rank, int ranks,
   220	                         bool copyResult, double &elapsed) {
   221	  const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
   222	  const size_t tileElements = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * blockSize;
   223	  const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
   224	  const size_t localBlocks = localBlockCount(rank, ranks, tileCount);
   225	
   226	  DeviceBuffer<double> deviceMatrix(localMatrix.size());
   227	  DeviceBuffer<double> deviceDiagonal(tileElements);
   228	  DeviceBuffer<double> devicePanel(paddedN * blockSize);
   229	  DeviceBuffer<int> deviceInfo(1);
   230	  if (!localMatrix.empty()) {
   231	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix.get(), localMatrix.data(),
   232	                          localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
   233	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   234	  }
   235	
   236	  cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   237	  cublasHandle_t blas = nullptr;
   238	  cusolverDnHandle_t solver = nullptr;
   239	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   240	  CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&blas));
   241	  CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnCreate(&solver));
   242	  CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(blas, stream));
   243	  CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnSetStream(solver, stream));
   244	
   245	  int workspaceElements = 0;
   246	  CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize(solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
   247	                                             blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(),
   248	                                             blockSize, &workspaceElements));
   249	  DeviceBuffer<double> workspace(static_cast<size_t>(workspaceElements));
   250	
   251	  PinnedBuffer<double> hostDiagonal(tileElements);
   252	  PinnedBuffer<double> hostSend(localBlocks * tileElements);
   253	  PinnedBuffer<double> hostGrouped(static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) *
   254	                                   tileElements);
   255	  PinnedBuffer<double> hostPanel(paddedN * blockSize);
   256	
   257	  std::vector<int> receiveCounts(ranks);
   258	  std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements(ranks);
   259	  bool positiveDefinite = true;
   260	  const double one = 1.0;
   261	  const double minusOne = -1.0;
   262	
   263	  // Allocation, handle creation, and the initial host-to-device transfer are
   264	  // setup costs rather than part of the factorization, just as allocation and
   265	  // input generation were outside the original benchmark's timed region. A
   266	  // one-element warm-up also keeps CUDA's lazy module loading out of the
   267	  // measurement while exercising every library operation used below.
   268	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
   269	                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   270	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePanel.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
   271	                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   272	  CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
   273	      solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, 1, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
   274	      workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
   275	  CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
   276	                           CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, 1, 1, &one,
   277	                           deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, devicePanel.get(),
   278	                           blockSize));
   279	  CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, 1, 1, 1, &one,
   280	                           deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
   281	                           deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, &one,
   282	                           devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
   283	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   284	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   285	  const double factorizationStart = MPI_Wtime();
   286	
   287	  for (int step = 0; step < tileCount; ++step) {
   288	    const int owner = step % ranks;
   289	    const int diagonalSize = static_cast<int>(
   290	        std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize));
   291	    int factorizationInfo = 0;
   292	
   293	    if (rank == owner) {
   294	      const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(step / ranks);
   295	      double *diagonal = deviceMatrix.get() + localSlot * blockStride +
   296	                         static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
   297	      CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
   298	          solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, diagonalSize, diagonal, blockSize,
   299	          workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
   300	      CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&factorizationInfo, deviceInfo.get(),
   301	                                 sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   302	      CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.get(), diagonal,
   303	                                 tileElements * sizeof(double),
   304	                                 cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   305	      CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   306	    }
   307	
   308	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&factorizationInfo, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   309	    if (factorizationInfo != 0) {
   310	      positiveDefinite = false;
   311	      if (rank == 0) {
   312	        if (factorizationInfo > 0) {
   313	          const size_t failedDiagonal =
   314	              static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize +
   315	              static_cast<size_t>(factorizationInfo - 1);
   316	          std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at "
   317	                      "diagonal element %zu\n",
   318	                      failedDiagonal);
   319	        } else {
   320	          std::printf("Error: cuSOLVER received an invalid argument %d\n",
   321	                      -factorizationInfo);
   322	        }
   323	      }
   324	      break;
   325	    }
   326	
   327	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.get(), static_cast<int>(tileElements),
   328	                        MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   329	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), hostDiagonal.get(),
   330	                               tileElements * sizeof(double),
   331	                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   332	
   333	    if (step + 1 == tileCount) {
   334	      continue;
   335	    }
   336	
   337	    // Every rank solves the panel tiles it owns. Block-cyclic ownership
   338	    // balances both the panel and the larger trailing updates.
   339	    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
   340	      const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
   341	      if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
   342	        continue;
   343	      }
   344	      const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
   345	          blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
   346	      double *panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
   347	                          static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
   348	      CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
   349	                               CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, rows,
   350	                               diagonalSize, &one, deviceDiagonal.get(),
   351	                               blockSize, panelTile, blockSize));
   352	    }
   353	
   354	    // Copy this rank's solved tiles in increasing global block-row order.
   355	    size_t sendTiles = 0;
   356	    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
   357	      const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
   358	      if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
   359	        continue;
   360	      }
   361	      const double *panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
   362	                                static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
   363	      CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostSend.get() + sendTiles * tileElements,
   364	                                 panelTile, tileElements * sizeof(double),
   365	                                 cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   366	      ++sendTiles;
   367	    }
   368	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   369	
   370	    std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
   371	    for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
   372	      const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
   373	      receiveCounts[blockOwner] += static_cast<int>(tileElements);
   374	    }
   375	    receiveDisplacements[0] = 0;
   376	    for (int process = 1; process < ranks; ++process) {
   377	      receiveDisplacements[process] =
   378	          receiveDisplacements[process - 1] + receiveCounts[process - 1];
   379	    }
   380	
   381	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(
   382	        hostSend.get(), static_cast<int>(sendTiles * tileElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
   383	        hostGrouped.get(), receiveCounts.data(), receiveDisplacements.data(),
   384	        MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   385	
   386	    // Allgatherv returns rank-major tiles. OpenMP transposes that metadata
   387	    // layout into one dense, column-major N-by-B panel for long DGEMMs.
   388	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   389	    for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
   390	      const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
   391	      const int skipped =
   392	          step < blockOwner ? 0 : (step - blockOwner) / ranks + 1;
   393	      const int rankSlot = (blockRow - blockOwner) / ranks;
   394	      const int activeSlot = rankSlot - skipped;
   395	      const double *source = hostGrouped.get() +
   396	                             receiveDisplacements[blockOwner] +
   397	                             static_cast<size_t>(activeSlot) * tileElements;
   398	      for (int column = 0; column < blockSize; ++column) {
   399	        std::memcpy(hostPanel.get() + static_cast<size_t>(column) * paddedN +
   400	                        static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize,
   401	                    source + static_cast<size_t>(column) * blockSize,
   402	                    static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * sizeof(double));
   403	      }
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    const size_t trailingStart = static_cast<size_t>(step + 1) * blockSize;
   407	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(
   408	        devicePanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
   409	        hostPanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
   410	        (paddedN - trailingStart) * sizeof(double), diagonalSize,
   411	        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   412	
   413	    // A complete local block row is contiguous by columns, so each update
   414	    // is a high-throughput DGEMM instead of a large collection of tiny GEMMs.
   415	    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
   416	      const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
   417	      if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
   418	        continue;
   419	      }
   420	      const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
   421	          blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
   422	      const size_t rowEnd =
   423	          std::min<size_t>(n, static_cast<size_t>(blockRow + 1) * blockSize);
   424	      const int columns = static_cast<int>(rowEnd - trailingStart);
   425	      const double *leftPanel = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
   426	                                static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
   427	      const double *rightPanel = devicePanel.get() + trailingStart;
   428	      double *trailing =
   429	          deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride + trailingStart * blockSize;
   430	      CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, rows, columns,
   431	                               diagonalSize, &minusOne, leftPanel, blockSize,
   432	                               rightPanel, static_cast<int>(paddedN), &one,
   433	                               trailing, blockSize));
   434	    }
   435	  }
   436	
   437	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   438	  const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - factorizationStart;
   439	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   440	                       MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   441	  if (positiveDefinite && copyResult && !localMatrix.empty()) {
   442	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localMatrix.data(), deviceMatrix.get(),
   443	                          localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
   444	                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   445	  }
   446	
   447	  CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDestroy(solver));
   448	  CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(blas));
   449	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
   450	  return positiveDefinite;
   451	}
   452	
   453	bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double> &lower,
   454	                      const std::vector<double> &original, size_t n) {
   455	  double maxError = 0.0;
   456	  double relativeError = 0.0;
   457	
   458	#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)                          \
   459	    reduction(max : maxError, relativeError)
   460	  for (long long iValue = 0; iValue < static_cast<long long>(n); ++iValue) {
   461	    for (long long jValue = 0; jValue < static_cast<long long>(n); ++jValue) {
   462	      const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(iValue);
   463	      const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(jValue);
   464	      double reconstructed = 0.0;
   465	      const size_t last = std::min(i, j);
   466	      for (size_t k = 0; k <= last; ++k) {
   467	        reconstructed += lower[i * n + k] * lower[j * n + k];
   468	      }
   469	      const double error = std::fabs(reconstructed - original[i * n + j]);
   470	      maxError = std::max(maxError, error);
   470	      maxError = std::max(maxError, error);
   471	      const double relative =
   472	          error / (std::fabs(original[i * n + j]) + 1.0e-10);
   473	      relativeError = std::max(relativeError, relative);
   474	    }
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  std::printf("Max absolute error: %.10e\n", maxError);
   478	  std::printf("Max relative error: %.10e\n", relativeError);
   479	  if (relativeError > 1.0e-6) {
   480	    std::printf("Validation failed: relative error too large\n");
   481	    return false;
   482	  }
   483	  return true;
   484	}
   485	
   486	void printUsage(const char *programName) {
   487	  std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
   488	  std::printf("Options:\n");
   489	  std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");
   490	  std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   491	  std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   492	  std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   493	}
   494	
   495	bool parseSize(const char *argument, size_t &value) {
   496	  errno = 0;
   497	  char *end = nullptr;
   498	  const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argument, &end, 10);
   499	  if (errno != 0 || end == argument || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
   500	      parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
   501	    return false;
   502	  }
   503	  value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
   504	  return true;
   505	}

   509	int main(int argc, char **argv) {
   510	  int providedThreadLevel = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   511	  const int initializeStatus =
   512	      MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &providedThreadLevel);
   513	  if (initializeStatus != MPI_SUCCESS) {
   514	    std::fprintf(stderr, "Unable to initialize MPI\n");
   515	    return EXIT_FAILURE;
   516	  }
   517	  if (providedThreadLevel < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   518	    abortParallel("MPI thread support", providedThreadLevel,
   519	                  "MPI_Init_thread(MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED)", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   520	  }
   521	
   522	  int rank = 0;
   523	  int ranks = 1;
   524	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank));
   525	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks));
   526	
   527	  size_t n = 512;
   528	  bool validate = false;
   529	  bool printResults = false;
   530	  bool showHelp = false;
   531	  bool argumentsValid = true;
   532	  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   533	    if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   534	      if (!parseSize(argv[++i], n)) {
   535	        argumentsValid = false;
   536	      }
   537	    } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   538	      validate = true;
   539	    } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   540	      printResults = true;
   541	    } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   542	      showHelp = true;
   543	    } else {
   544	      if (rank == 0) {
   545	        std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   546	      }
   547	      argumentsValid = false;
   548	    }
   549	  }
   550	
   551	  size_t matrixElements = 0;
   552	  if (!checkedSquare(n, matrixElements)) {
   553	    argumentsValid = false;
   554	  }
   555	  if (showHelp || !argumentsValid) {
   556	    if (rank == 0) {
   557	      if (!argumentsValid) {
   558	        std::printf("Matrix size must be a positive, representable integer\n");
   559	      }
   560	      printUsage(argv[0]);
   561	    }
   562	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   563	    return argumentsValid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   564	  }
   565	
   566	  // One MPI process drives one node-local GPU. This is stable across nodes
   567	  // because local rank, rather than global rank, selects the CUDA device.
   568	  MPI_Comm localCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   569	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
   570	                                MPI_INFO_NULL, &localCommunicator));
   571	  int localRank = 0;
   572	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(localCommunicator, &localRank));
   573	  int deviceCount = 0;
   574	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   575	  if (deviceCount == 0) {
   576	    abortParallel("CUDA", static_cast<int>(cudaErrorNoDevice),
   577	                  "at least one CUDA device is required", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   578	  }
   579	  const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   580	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   581	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   582	  cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   583	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   584	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
   585	
   586	  const int blockSize =
   587	      static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(kDefaultBlockSize, n));
   588	  const int tileCount = static_cast<int>((n + blockSize - 1) / blockSize);
   589	  const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
   590	  const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
   591	  size_t paddedElements = 0;
   592	  if (!checkedSquare(paddedN, paddedElements) || paddedElements > INT_MAX) {
   593	    if (rank == 0) {
   594	      std::fprintf(stderr, "Matrix is too large for this MPI implementation's "
   595	                           "32-bit collective counts\n");
   596	    }
   597	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   598	    return EXIT_FAILURE;
   599	  }
   600	
   601	  std::vector<int> elementCounts(ranks);
   602	  std::vector<int> elementDisplacements(ranks);
   603	  for (int process = 0; process < ranks; ++process) {
   604	    const size_t count =
   605	        localBlockCount(process, ranks, tileCount) * blockStride;
   606	    elementCounts[process] = static_cast<int>(count);
   607	    if (process > 0) {
   608	      elementDisplacements[process] =
   609	          elementDisplacements[process - 1] + elementCounts[process - 1];
   610	    }
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  if (rank == 0) {
   614	    std::printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
   615	    std::printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", n, n);
   616	    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   617	    std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI rank%s, up to %d OpenMP thread%s "
   618	                "per rank, CUDA (%s)\n",
   619	                ranks, ranks == 1 ? "" : "s", omp_get_max_threads(),
   620	                omp_get_max_threads() == 1 ? "" : "s", deviceProperties.name);
   621	    std::printf("Block size: %d\n", blockSize);
   622	  }
   623	
   624	  std::vector<double> original;
   625	  std::vector<double> rootPacked;
   626	  if (rank == 0) {
   627	    original.resize(matrixElements);
   628	    std::printf("Generating positive definite matrix...\n");
   629	    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(original, n);
   630	    rootPacked.assign(paddedElements, 0.0);
   631	    packDistributedMatrix(original, rootPacked, n, blockSize, tileCount, ranks,
   632	                          elementDisplacements);
   633	    if (!validate) {
   634	      std::vector<double>().swap(original);
   635	    }
   636	  }
   637	
   638	  std::vector<double> localMatrix(static_cast<size_t>(elementCounts[rank]));
   639	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Scatterv(rank == 0 ? rootPacked.data() : nullptr,
   640	                         elementCounts.data(), elementDisplacements.data(),
   641	                         MPI_DOUBLE, localMatrix.data(), elementCounts[rank],
   642	                         MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   643	  if (rank == 0) {
   644	    std::vector<double>().swap(rootPacked);
   645	    std::printf("Computing Cholesky decomposition...\n");
   646	  }
   647	
   648	  double elapsed = 0.0;
   649	  const bool needResult = validate || printResults;
   650	  const bool success = distributedCholesky(localMatrix, n, blockSize, tileCount,
   651	                                           rank, ranks, needResult, elapsed);
   652	
   653	  if (!success) {
   654	    if (rank == 0) {
   655	      std::printf("Cholesky decomposition failed\n");
   656	    }
   657	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   658	    return EXIT_FAILURE;
   659	  }
   660	
   661	  if (rank == 0) {
   662	    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsed * 1000.0);
   663	    const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * n * n / 3.0;
   664	    std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", operations / elapsed / 1.0e9);
   665	  }
   666	
   667	  int exitStatus = EXIT_SUCCESS;
   668	  if (needResult) {
   669	    if (rank == 0) {
   670	      rootPacked.resize(paddedElements);
   671	    }
   672	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localMatrix.data(), elementCounts[rank], MPI_DOUBLE,
   673	                          rank == 0 ? rootPacked.data() : nullptr,
   674	                          elementCounts.data(), elementDisplacements.data(),
   675	                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   676	  }
   677	  if (rank == 0 && needResult) {
   678	    std::vector<double> result(matrixElements);
   679	    unpackDistributedMatrix(rootPacked, result, n, blockSize, tileCount, ranks,
   680	                            elementDisplacements);
   681	    if (printResults) {
   682	      print_results(result, "CholeskyL");
   683	    }
   684	    if (validate) {
   685	      std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   686	      if (validateCholesky(result, original, n)) {
   687	        std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   688	      } else {
   689	        std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   690	        exitStatus = EXIT_FAILURE;
   691	      }
   692	    }
   693	  }
   694	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&exitStatus, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   695	  MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   696	  return exitStatus;
   697	}

+// Convert root's row-major matrix into rank-major, block-cyclic row storage.
+// Each local block row is column-major on the GPU, permitting one large DGEMM
+// per owned tile row during every trailing update.
+void packDistributedMatrix(const std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                           std::vector<double>& packed, size_t n, int blockSize,
+                           int tileCount, int ranks,
+                           const std::vector<int>& displacements) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int blockRow = 0; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+        const int owner = blockRow % ranks;
+        const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow / ranks);
+        double* destination = packed.data() + displacements[owner] +
+                              localSlot * blockStride;
+        const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
+        const size_t rows = std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - globalRow);
+        for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
+            for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
+                destination[column * blockSize + row] =
+                    matrix[(globalRow + row) * n + column];
+            }
+        }
     }
 }

+bool distributedCholesky(std::vector<double>& localMatrix, size_t n,
+                         int blockSize, int tileCount, int rank, int ranks,
+                         bool copyResult, double& elapsed) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t tileElements = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+    const size_t localBlocks = localBlockCount(rank, ranks, tileCount);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceMatrix(localMatrix.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceDiagonal(tileElements);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> devicePanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> deviceInfo(1);
+    if (!localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix.get(), localMatrix.data(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
+    cublasHandle_t blas = nullptr;
+    cusolverDnHandle_t solver = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&blas));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnCreate(&solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(blas, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnSetStream(solver, stream));
+
+    int workspaceElements = 0;
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(),
+        blockSize, &workspaceElements));
+    DeviceBuffer<double> workspace(static_cast<size_t>(workspaceElements));
+
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostDiagonal(tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostSend(localBlocks * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostGrouped(static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostPanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(ranks);
+    std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements(ranks);
+    bool positiveDefinite = true;
+    const double one = 1.0;
+    const double minusOne = -1.0;
+
+    // Allocation, handle creation, and the initial host-to-device transfer are
+    // setup costs rather than part of the factorization, just as allocation and
+    // input generation were outside the original benchmark's timed region. A
+    // one-element warm-up also keeps CUDA's lazy module loading out of the
+    // measurement while exercising every library operation used below.
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePanel.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, 1, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, CUBLAS_OP_T,
+        CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, 1, 1, &one, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, 1, 1, 1, &one,
+        deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, &one,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    const double factorizationStart = MPI_Wtime();
+
+    for (int step = 0; step < tileCount; ++step) {
+        const int owner = step % ranks;
+        const int diagonalSize = static_cast<int>(
+            std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize));
+        int factorizationInfo = 0;
+
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(step / ranks);
+            double* diagonal = deviceMatrix.get() + localSlot * blockStride +
+                               static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+                solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, diagonalSize, diagonal,
+                blockSize, workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&factorizationInfo, deviceInfo.get(),
+                                       sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.get(), diagonal,
+                                       tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&factorizationInfo, 1, MPI_INT, owner,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (factorizationInfo != 0) {
+            positiveDefinite = false;
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (factorizationInfo > 0) {
+                    const size_t failedDiagonal =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize +
+                        static_cast<size_t>(factorizationInfo - 1);
+                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at "
+                                "diagonal element %zu\n",
+                                failedDiagonal);
+                } else {
+                    std::printf("Error: cuSOLVER received an invalid argument %d\n",
+                                -factorizationInfo);
+                }
+            }
+            break;
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.get(), static_cast<int>(tileElements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), hostDiagonal.get(),
+                                   tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        if (step + 1 == tileCount) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Every rank solves the panel tiles it owns. Block-cyclic ownership
+        // balances both the panel and the larger trailing updates.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
+                CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, rows, diagonalSize, &one,
+                deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, panelTile, blockSize));
+        }
+
+        // Copy this rank's solved tiles in increasing global block-row order.
+        size_t sendTiles = 0;
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostSend.get() + sendTiles * tileElements,
+                                       panelTile, tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            ++sendTiles;
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+        std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            receiveCounts[blockOwner] += static_cast<int>(tileElements);
+        }
+        receiveDisplacements[0] = 0;
+        for (int process = 1; process < ranks; ++process) {
+            receiveDisplacements[process] = receiveDisplacements[process - 1] +
+                                            receiveCounts[process - 1];
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(
+            hostSend.get(), static_cast<int>(sendTiles * tileElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
+            hostGrouped.get(), receiveCounts.data(), receiveDisplacements.data(),
+            MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+        // Allgatherv returns rank-major tiles. OpenMP transposes that metadata
+        // layout into one dense, column-major N-by-B panel for long DGEMMs.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            const int skipped = step < blockOwner
+                                    ? 0
+                                    : (step - blockOwner) / ranks + 1;
+            const int rankSlot = (blockRow - blockOwner) / ranks;
+            const int activeSlot = rankSlot - skipped;
+            const double* source = hostGrouped.get() +
+                                   receiveDisplacements[blockOwner] +
+                                   static_cast<size_t>(activeSlot) * tileElements;
+            for (int column = 0; column < blockSize; ++column) {
+                std::memcpy(hostPanel.get() +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(column) * paddedN +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize,
+                            source + static_cast<size_t>(column) * blockSize,
+                            static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * sizeof(double));
+            }
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingStart = static_cast<size_t>(step + 1) * blockSize;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(
+            devicePanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            hostPanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            (paddedN - trailingStart) * sizeof(double), diagonalSize,
+            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        // A complete local block row is contiguous by columns, so each update
+        // is a high-throughput DGEMM instead of a large collection of tiny GEMMs.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            const size_t rowEnd = std::min<size_t>(
+                n, static_cast<size_t>(blockRow + 1) * blockSize);
+            const int columns = static_cast<int>(rowEnd - trailingStart);
+            const double* leftPanel = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            const double* rightPanel = devicePanel.get() + trailingStart;
+            double* trailing = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                               trailingStart * blockSize;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, rows, columns, diagonalSize,
+                &minusOne, leftPanel, blockSize, rightPanel,
+                static_cast<int>(paddedN), &one, trailing, blockSize));
+        }
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - factorizationStart;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
+                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    if (positiveDefinite && copyResult && !localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localMatrix.data(), deviceMatrix.get(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDestroy(solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(blas));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    return positiveDefinite;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* argument, size_t& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argument, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == argument || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+// Convert root's row-major matrix into rank-major, block-cyclic row storage.
+// Each local block row is column-major on the GPU, permitting one large DGEMM
+// per owned tile row during every trailing update.
+void packDistributedMatrix(const std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                           std::vector<double>& packed, size_t n, int blockSize,
+                           int tileCount, int ranks,
+                           const std::vector<int>& displacements) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int blockRow = 0; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+        const int owner = blockRow % ranks;
+        const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow / ranks);
+        double* destination = packed.data() + displacements[owner] +
+                              localSlot * blockStride;
+        const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
+        const size_t rows = std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - globalRow);
+        for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
+            for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
+                destination[column * blockSize + row] =
+                    matrix[(globalRow + row) * n + column];
+            }
+        }
     }

+bool distributedCholesky(std::vector<double>& localMatrix, size_t n,
+                         int blockSize, int tileCount, int rank, int ranks,
+                         bool copyResult, double& elapsed) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t tileElements = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+    const size_t localBlocks = localBlockCount(rank, ranks, tileCount);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceMatrix(localMatrix.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceDiagonal(tileElements);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> devicePanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> deviceInfo(1);
+    if (!localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix.get(), localMatrix.data(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
+    cublasHandle_t blas = nullptr;
+    cusolverDnHandle_t solver = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&blas));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnCreate(&solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(blas, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnSetStream(solver, stream));
+
+    int workspaceElements = 0;
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(),
+        blockSize, &workspaceElements));
+    DeviceBuffer<double> workspace(static_cast<size_t>(workspaceElements));
+
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostDiagonal(tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostSend(localBlocks * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostGrouped(static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostPanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(ranks);
+    std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements(ranks);
+    bool positiveDefinite = true;
+    const double one = 1.0;
+    const double minusOne = -1.0;
+
+    // Allocation, handle creation, and the initial host-to-device transfer are
+    // setup costs rather than part of the factorization, just as allocation and
+    // input generation were outside the original benchmark's timed region. A
+    // one-element warm-up also keeps CUDA's lazy module loading out of the
+    // measurement while exercising every library operation used below.
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePanel.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, 1, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, CUBLAS_OP_T,
+        CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, 1, 1, &one, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, 1, 1, 1, &one,
+        deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, &one,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    const double factorizationStart = MPI_Wtime();
+
+    for (int step = 0; step < tileCount; ++step) {
+        const int owner = step % ranks;
+        const int diagonalSize = static_cast<int>(
+            std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize));
+        int factorizationInfo = 0;
+
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(step / ranks);
+            double* diagonal = deviceMatrix.get() + localSlot * blockStride +
+                               static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+                solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, diagonalSize, diagonal,
+                blockSize, workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&factorizationInfo, deviceInfo.get(),
+                                       sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.get(), diagonal,
+                                       tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&factorizationInfo, 1, MPI_INT, owner,

+        if (factorizationInfo != 0) {

+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (factorizationInfo > 0) {
+                    const size_t failedDiagonal =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize +

+                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at "
+                                "diagonal element %zu\n",
+                                failedDiagonal);
+                } else {
+                    std::printf("Error: cuSOLVER received an invalid argument %d\n",
+                                -factorizationInfo);
+                }
+            }
+            break;
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.get(), static_cast<int>(tileElements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), hostDiagonal.get(),
+                                   tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        if (step + 1 == tileCount) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Every rank solves the panel tiles it owns. Block-cyclic ownership
+        // balances both the panel and the larger trailing updates.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
+                CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, rows, diagonalSize, &one,
+                deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, panelTile, blockSize));
+        }
+
+        // Copy this rank's solved tiles in increasing global block-row order.
+        size_t sendTiles = 0;
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostSend.get() + sendTiles * tileElements,
+                                       panelTile, tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            ++sendTiles;
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+        std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            receiveCounts[blockOwner] += static_cast<int>(tileElements);
+        }
+        receiveDisplacements[0] = 0;
+        for (int process = 1; process < ranks; ++process) {
+            receiveDisplacements[process] = receiveDisplacements[process - 1] +
+                                            receiveCounts[process - 1];
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(
+            hostSend.get(), static_cast<int>(sendTiles * tileElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
+            hostGrouped.get(), receiveCounts.data(), receiveDisplacements.data(),
+            MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+        // Allgatherv returns rank-major tiles. OpenMP transposes that metadata
+        // layout into one dense, column-major N-by-B panel for long DGEMMs.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            const int skipped = step < blockOwner
+                                    ? 0
+                                    : (step - blockOwner) / ranks + 1;
+            const int rankSlot = (blockRow - blockOwner) / ranks;
+            const int activeSlot = rankSlot - skipped;
+            const double* source = hostGrouped.get() +
+                                   receiveDisplacements[blockOwner] +
+                                   static_cast<size_t>(activeSlot) * tileElements;
+            for (int column = 0; column < blockSize; ++column) {
+                std::memcpy(hostPanel.get() +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(column) * paddedN +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize,
+                            source + static_cast<size_t>(column) * blockSize,
+                            static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * sizeof(double));
+            }
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingStart = static_cast<size_t>(step + 1) * blockSize;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(
+            devicePanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            hostPanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            (paddedN - trailingStart) * sizeof(double), diagonalSize,
+            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        // A complete local block row is contiguous by columns, so each update
+        // is a high-throughput DGEMM instead of a large collection of tiny GEMMs.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            const size_t rowEnd = std::min<size_t>(
+                n, static_cast<size_t>(blockRow + 1) * blockSize);
+            const int columns = static_cast<int>(rowEnd - trailingStart);
+            const double* leftPanel = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            const double* rightPanel = devicePanel.get() + trailingStart;
+            double* trailing = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                               trailingStart * blockSize;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, rows, columns, diagonalSize,
+                &minusOne, leftPanel, blockSize, rightPanel,
+                static_cast<int>(paddedN), &one, trailing, blockSize));
+        }
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - factorizationStart;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
+                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    if (positiveDefinite && copyResult && !localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localMatrix.data(), deviceMatrix.get(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDestroy(solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(blas));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    return positiveDefinite;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* argument, size_t& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argument, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == argument || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

codex
Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky benchmark without adding source files or changing the `cholesky` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI block-cyclic row distribution with approximately \(N^2/P\) factor storage per rank.
- Node-local MPI rank-to-GPU assignment.
- cuSOLVER diagonal factorization and cuBLAS `DTRSM`/`DGEMM` updates.
- Pinned-memory MPI panel communication.
- OpenMP-parallel generation, packing, reconstruction, and validation.
- CUDA initialization excluded from benchmark timing.
- Result gathering skipped unless `-v` or `-r` requires it.
- CMake now requires and links MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, cuBLAS, and cuSOLVER.

Validation completed successfully with 1–4 MPI ranks, including partial blocks and more ranks than tiles. A 2-rank 1000×1000 run produced a maximum relative error of `3.36e-11`; CUDA memcheck reported zero errors. Result hashes were identical between single- and multi-rank executions.

+[[noreturn]] void abortParallel(const char* library, int code, const char* expression,
+                                const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s error %d in %s at %s:%d\n", rank, library,

+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, code == 0 ? EXIT_FAILURE : code);
+    }
+    std::abort();
+}

+// Convert root's row-major matrix into rank-major, block-cyclic row storage.
+// Each local block row is column-major on the GPU, permitting one large DGEMM
+// per owned tile row during every trailing update.
+void packDistributedMatrix(const std::vector<double>& matrix,
+                           std::vector<double>& packed, size_t n, int blockSize,
+                           int tileCount, int ranks,
+                           const std::vector<int>& displacements) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int blockRow = 0; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+        const int owner = blockRow % ranks;
+        const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow / ranks);
+        double* destination = packed.data() + displacements[owner] +
+                              localSlot * blockStride;
+        const size_t globalRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize;
+        const size_t rows = std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - globalRow);
+        for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
+            for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
+                destination[column * blockSize + row] =
+                    matrix[(globalRow + row) * n + column];
+            }
+        }
     }

+bool distributedCholesky(std::vector<double>& localMatrix, size_t n,
+                         int blockSize, int tileCount, int rank, int ranks,
+                         bool copyResult, double& elapsed) {
+    const size_t paddedN = static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * blockSize;
+    const size_t tileElements = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * blockSize;
+    const size_t blockStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * paddedN;
+    const size_t localBlocks = localBlockCount(rank, ranks, tileCount);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceMatrix(localMatrix.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceDiagonal(tileElements);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> devicePanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> deviceInfo(1);
+    if (!localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix.get(), localMatrix.data(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
+    cublasHandle_t blas = nullptr;
+    cusolverDnHandle_t solver = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&blas));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnCreate(&solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(blas, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnSetStream(solver, stream));
+
+    int workspaceElements = 0;
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(),
+        blockSize, &workspaceElements));
+    DeviceBuffer<double> workspace(static_cast<size_t>(workspaceElements));
+
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostDiagonal(tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostSend(localBlocks * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostGrouped(static_cast<size_t>(tileCount) * tileElements);
+    PinnedBuffer<double> hostPanel(paddedN * blockSize);
+
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(ranks);
+    std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements(ranks);
+    bool positiveDefinite = true;
+    const double one = 1.0;
+    const double minusOne = -1.0;
+
+    // Allocation, handle creation, and the initial host-to-device transfer are
+    // setup costs rather than part of the factorization, just as allocation and
+    // input generation were outside the original benchmark's timed region. A
+    // one-element warm-up also keeps CUDA's lazy module loading out of the
+    // measurement while exercising every library operation used below.
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePanel.get(), &one, sizeof(double),
+                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+        solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, 1, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, CUBLAS_OP_T,
+        CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, 1, 1, &one, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+        blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, 1, 1, 1, &one,
+        deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, &one,
+        devicePanel.get(), blockSize));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    const double factorizationStart = MPI_Wtime();
+
+    for (int step = 0; step < tileCount; ++step) {
+        const int owner = step % ranks;
+        const int diagonalSize = static_cast<int>(
+            std::min<size_t>(blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize));
+        int factorizationInfo = 0;
+
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            const size_t localSlot = static_cast<size_t>(step / ranks);
+            double* diagonal = deviceMatrix.get() + localSlot * blockStride +
+                               static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDpotrf(
+                solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, diagonalSize, diagonal,
+                blockSize, workspace.get(), workspaceElements, deviceInfo.get()));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&factorizationInfo, deviceInfo.get(),
+                                       sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.get(), diagonal,
+                                       tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&factorizationInfo, 1, MPI_INT, owner,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (factorizationInfo != 0) {
+            positiveDefinite = false;
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (factorizationInfo > 0) {
+                    const size_t failedDiagonal =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(step) * blockSize +
+                        static_cast<size_t>(factorizationInfo - 1);
+                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at "
+                                "diagonal element %zu\n",
+                                failedDiagonal);
+                } else {
+                    std::printf("Error: cuSOLVER received an invalid argument %d\n",
+                                -factorizationInfo);
+                }
+            }
+            break;
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.get(), static_cast<int>(tileElements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceDiagonal.get(), hostDiagonal.get(),
+                                   tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        if (step + 1 == tileCount) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Every rank solves the panel tiles it owns. Block-cyclic ownership
+        // balances both the panel and the larger trailing updates.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_RIGHT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
+                CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, rows, diagonalSize, &one,
+                deviceDiagonal.get(), blockSize, panelTile, blockSize));
+        }
+
+        // Copy this rank's solved tiles in increasing global block-row order.
+        size_t sendTiles = 0;
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double* panelTile = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostSend.get() + sendTiles * tileElements,
+                                       panelTile, tileElements * sizeof(double),
+                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+            ++sendTiles;
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+        std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            receiveCounts[blockOwner] += static_cast<int>(tileElements);
+        }
+        receiveDisplacements[0] = 0;
+        for (int process = 1; process < ranks; ++process) {
+            receiveDisplacements[process] = receiveDisplacements[process - 1] +
+                                            receiveCounts[process - 1];
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(
+            hostSend.get(), static_cast<int>(sendTiles * tileElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
+            hostGrouped.get(), receiveCounts.data(), receiveDisplacements.data(),
+            MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+        // Allgatherv returns rank-major tiles. OpenMP transposes that metadata
+        // layout into one dense, column-major N-by-B panel for long DGEMMs.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+        for (int blockRow = step + 1; blockRow < tileCount; ++blockRow) {
+            const int blockOwner = blockRow % ranks;
+            const int skipped = step < blockOwner
+                                    ? 0
+                                    : (step - blockOwner) / ranks + 1;
+            const int rankSlot = (blockRow - blockOwner) / ranks;
+            const int activeSlot = rankSlot - skipped;
+            const double* source = hostGrouped.get() +
+                                   receiveDisplacements[blockOwner] +
+                                   static_cast<size_t>(activeSlot) * tileElements;
+            for (int column = 0; column < blockSize; ++column) {
+                std::memcpy(hostPanel.get() +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(column) * paddedN +
+                                static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize,
+                            source + static_cast<size_t>(column) * blockSize,
+                            static_cast<size_t>(blockSize) * sizeof(double));
+            }
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingStart = static_cast<size_t>(step + 1) * blockSize;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(
+            devicePanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            hostPanel.get() + trailingStart, paddedN * sizeof(double),
+            (paddedN - trailingStart) * sizeof(double), diagonalSize,
+            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+
+        // A complete local block row is contiguous by columns, so each update
+        // is a high-throughput DGEMM instead of a large collection of tiny GEMMs.
+        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < localBlocks; ++slot) {
+            const int blockRow = rank + static_cast<int>(slot) * ranks;
+            if (blockRow <= step || blockRow >= tileCount) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const int rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+                blockSize, n - static_cast<size_t>(blockRow) * blockSize));
+            const size_t rowEnd = std::min<size_t>(
+                n, static_cast<size_t>(blockRow + 1) * blockSize);
+            const int columns = static_cast<int>(rowEnd - trailingStart);
+            const double* leftPanel = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(step) * tileElements;
+            const double* rightPanel = devicePanel.get() + trailingStart;
+            double* trailing = deviceMatrix.get() + slot * blockStride +
+                               trailingStart * blockSize;
+            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(
+                blas, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_T, rows, columns, diagonalSize,
+                &minusOne, leftPanel, blockSize, rightPanel,
+                static_cast<int>(paddedN), &one, trailing, blockSize));
+        }
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - factorizationStart;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
+                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    if (positiveDefinite && copyResult && !localMatrix.empty()) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localMatrix.data(), deviceMatrix.get(),
+                              localMatrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnDestroy(solver));
+    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(blas));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    return positiveDefinite;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* argument, size_t& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argument, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == argument || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky benchmark without adding source files or changing the `cholesky` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI block-cyclic row distribution with approximately \(N^2/P\) factor storage per rank.
- Node-local MPI rank-to-GPU assignment.
- cuSOLVER diagonal factorization and cuBLAS `DTRSM`/`DGEMM` updates.
- Pinned-memory MPI panel communication.
- OpenMP-parallel generation, packing, reconstruction, and validation.
- CUDA initialization excluded from benchmark timing.
- Result gathering skipped unless `-v` or `-r` requires it.
- CMake now requires and links MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, cuBLAS, and cuSOLVER.
